<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Weekly Market Performance:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty extended weekly gains, supported by robust earnings, IT sector strength, and synchronized buying from both FIIs and DIIs.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQNzFGZ1hQSXNDZlh2M1hzVVlQNmRlbGhoWG5ISnFvcE9HbjRwYVFMakZxa045aEZVREZ1cFdXeVB0d3pGY1RDeVdZWGR1ZS1NNDJ0c3VUTF9RbFE0ZFBRRnl1WDRzQUVHZFNmSlcwdk9GcHF3aWhlSlVyYmFUWFc5a2VPeFlITFNSZmgxcHFKTG55dm4zYUhWQnJ0bXpZZGttY2tRQ1RBZU04UnVodVpJUjdlQ1h2QVNRdVNWbU1UNEg?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>RBI Monetary Policy:</strong> The RBI maintained a status quo on interest rates, with expectations that strong economic growth and easing inflation will support a continued pause in the near term.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Outlook:</strong> While SEBI notes that India&#x27;s resilient economy provides a solid foundation for markets, investors remain focused on global risks, crude oil price fluctuations, and upcoming Q1 earnings.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxQYmduLU5UYjhpWF9WbkRoTGlWVmZKVFRlY2xKcld5Wkp4czY4elA3ZXNjXy10eFA2OExuaEJxc29RdnVHdTZGXzRUcUdpYVBSU25FZXF3OWx4LVM4WlV2c0dpVXhiNVhzOC1aSTZCMnNmc1dHQ241YWJrN3NoRHRuN1VObG9mZzlxdERRRVZnbDdrYzhJd2d3bngwYURscTRjZ2xZV0UxaWNCbEdXT3lkeUZRWHRSYzRpNVlDR25TM1EzZ2VnVVBteDM1X2g?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a></span></li>
